item.title: Gourmia Recalls 9-Slice Digital Air Fryer Ovens Due to Burn Hazard
item.company: Sold At: Target stores nationwide and online at Target.com from October 2021 through June 2026 for about $150.
item.brand: Sold At: Target stores nationwide and online at Target.com from October 2021 through June 2026 for about $150.
item.product: Gourmia Stainless Steel Digital 9 Slice Digital Air Fryer Ovens
item.summary: This recall involves Gourmia 9-SliceDigitalAir Fryer Ovens with model number GTF7530, and UPC Code 810002862779. The recalled ovens are stainless steel and have two spring-loaded glass front French doors with metal handles. The Ovens can be identified with model and UPC codes on packaging. The Model number GTF7530 and codes 3021 to 0126 can also be found on a label on back of the unit.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Gourmia Stainless Steel Digital 9 Slice Digital Air Fryer Ovens.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled Ovens immediately and contact Gourmia for a free repair kit by mail. The repair kit will include an added doorstop and instructions on how to install.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
